cases.text:
Hello!

Welcome to the Practice with Vasanth's AI series on careerwithvasanth.com.

I'm Vasanth's trainer assistant for your 1-on-1 mock practice. Vasanth has trained me directly on ten and half hours of his training material, notes and company tagged questions. He has curated this for his learners to reflect his probing style and judgement.

In this practice round, we will look at how well you are able to defend your claims on your resume, especially quantified claims.

I'll turn off my video now so you can focus entirely on the workspace. Afterward, I'll send a detailed performance report to both you and Vasanth. Give it your best. Let's dive in!
